<script setup lang="ts">
// 手動の実ヘルパー 🍣
import { definePage } from 'vue-router/experimental'
import type { _RoutePropsForFilePath } from 'vue-router/experimental'
type PageFile = 'src/pages/products/[id=int].vue'
const props = defineProps<_RoutePropsForFilePath<PageFile>>()
definePage<PageFile, typeof import('./[id=int].vue').default>({
  params: {
    query: { page: { parser: 'int', format: 'value', default: 1 }, tags: { parser: 'string', format: 'array' }, at: { parser: 'date', format: 'value' } },
    hash: { heading: {} },
  },
  props: true,
})
const id: number = props.id
const page: number = props.page
const tags: string[] | undefined = props.tags
const at: Date | undefined = props.at
const heading: string | undefined = props.heading
</script>
<template><div>{{ props.id.toFixed() }} {{ props.page.toFixed() }} {{ props.at?.toISOString() }}</div></template>
